Chapter 10 - Scripting Components / Scripting Components Reference

Required Scripting Component Routines

This section describes the routines that all scripting components must support. Your application can use these routines to save and load script data, execute and dispose of scripts, get script information, and manipulate the active function. "Optional Scripting Component Routines," which begins on page 10-45, describes additional routines your application can use with scripting components that support them.
